verdict.rationale: Activation strategies let you enable and disable features for certain users. Strategy constraints can be packaged as reusable segments across flags. Edge docs confirm that targeting rules use user IDs and emails, which implies per-user allowlisting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-ID allowlist/inclusion lists, explicit exclusion (deny-list) of specific users, a beta-tester or internal-account targeting example, and independent hands-on corroboration.
